description: Case design retained for independent audit; not delivered wholesale to participants.
brief: AI-assisted logistics at three fictional depots: 220 dispatch workers; reported exception rate changed from 11% to 17% after AI rollout; faster routine routing. Sponsor asks whether a six-item practice check can certify independent competence. Improve exception handling within one week without assuming training is the cause.

ops.profession: Dispatch operations and workplace-training implementation lead
ops.authority: May change handoff ownership and schedule practice; cannot alter AI model or certify assessment validity.

analyst.authority: May specify monitoring and analysis; cannot order staff or declare independent competence.

scientist.authority: Advice only; cannot schedule staff or certify competence from this evidence.

cost_rule: Costs cover scoped project work. Combine or narrow activities only with explicit accounting and realistic capacity. Expert fee counts. No cost-free invented personnel or specialist signoff.
